name: IWF World Championship
epitaph: Defended by Xtreme Limits against Rob Cole inside an Ultimate X Cage at the promotion's own Hostile Takeover pay-per-view.

name: IWF Television Championship
epitaph: Taken by Jackson Phillips from Eric Draven, then defended against Ron Nasty at the promotion's own Hostile Takeover pay-per-view.

name: IWF North American Championship
epitaph: A newly created title, put on the line for the first time ever between Eric Draven and Sinister at the promotion's own Hostile Takeover pay-per-view.

name: IWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended by Fast & Furious against the Rotten Bastards at the promotion's own Hostile Takeover pay-per-view.
